footer.about: Up To Code Plumbing is a Wichita plumbing company run by Ken Carrick. It handles drains, leaks, sewer lines, water heaters, fixtures and gas lines for homes and businesses.

why: On a phone, your current site is laid out about 980 pixels wide on a 390 pixel screen. The header buttons print over each other and the hero text is cut off. A visitor has to scroll sideways to read you.
George A. texted you a photo and got a fair quote right away. Today those words sit on Google, not on your site, and the text line is mentioned only on your booking and Augusta pages.
So the demo tells one story: send a photo, hear the price, decide. It opens with plumber in Wichita, KS, and gives sewer line repair and fixture installation a page each.

closing.heading: Want a website like this for your business?
closing.text: Your customers already describe the company you are. Book a strategy call with Fluid Frame and we’ll walk you through this demo and what a full build adds.

confirm.heading: What we'd confirm with you
confirm.intro: Google and AI tools see different answers about your business in different places. We wrote this demo from your reviews and your site. On a short onboarding call, we'd confirm these so everything says the same thing.
items: Your site says Up To Code was established in 2025, while the BBB lists a start date of 11/25/2024, so which founding year should every listing use?
Your Augusta page says weekdays 7:30 AM to 7 PM and weekends 9 AM to 4 PM, while your Thumbtack listing shows Sunday opening at 7 AM and Monday at 7 AM, so which hours should Google show?

Your homepage header lists towns from Goddard to Garden Plain, while your footer and About page list Wichita, Augusta, Haysville, Derby, El Dorado and nearby towns, so which list should every listing use?
Your About page says to text (316) 400-7586, while your other page lists (316) 333-5434 as the text line, so which number should take photos?

lead.heading: Why we led with the photo quote
lead.text: A page that says what every plumber says gives Google nothing to rank, so we built this one on things it can't find anywhere else. George A.'s photo quote and the Saturday and Sunday visits live in your Google reviews, alongside your own text line and towns. One review carries the photo quote, so tell us if that isn't how you work.

unverified.heading: What we couldn't verify, and why it matters
unverified.intro: We marked these on the demo as yellow "to confirm" tags instead of guessing, because we won't put a claim on your site we can't back up. Your site and your online listings disagree on a few of them, and the license number isn't printed anywhere.

items.why: Someone holding a big quote wants to look up the plumber's license before they trust a second opinion.
Your site, BBB and Thumbtack give different start dates, and a homeowner weighing a second opinion will notice.
Your site and Thumbtack list different weekend and weekday hours, and someone with water on the floor needs to know whether you'll answer.
